I. Fixing the Final JSON Error
Your last screenshot shows an
Error: Expecting value: line 1 column 1 (char 0)
. This happens because
termux-sensor
is returning an empty string or a permission warning instead of the expected data.
To fix this, we need to ensure the hardware link is active. Run this command:
Bash
termux-sensor -l
If you see a list of sensors:
The bridge is active.
If it returns nothing:
Go to your Android
Settings > Apps > Termux:API > Permissions
and ensure "Sensors" is allowed. You may also need to call
termux-sensor -s Magnetometer
once manually to trigger the Android permission pop-up.
